output.subject: Chicken breast fillets pricing
output.body:
Hi Munster Fresh Foods team,

Thank you for your reliable service and quality. We really value working with you and want to keep it that way.

We have seen lower pricing on one product and would like to ask you to match it. For the chicken breast fillets, we would need €17.00 per 2kg pack, about 4% lower. This is what the business needs to stay competitive.

If you can meet that price, we are happy to keep our regular weekly orders with you. Could you please reply by {reply_by_date}?

Thanks very much for considering it.

Kind regards,
Aoife
The Corner Café
